name: id_party
description: Party or list, GERDA normalized name

name: name
description: Party name in English (ParlGov) or a readable form of the GERDA name

name: left_right
description: Left-right ideology score from ParlGov (0 left to 10 right)

name: is_far_right
description: 1 if classified far right by GERDA, else 0

name: is_far_left
description: 1 if classified far left by GERDA (excluding Die Linke/PDS), else 0

name: is_cdu_csu
description: 1 if the party is CDU or CSU, else 0

name: category
description: Row category: party, residual_other, local_voter_groups, or independents
